'''Rynert''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] resident of the [[Taloraan City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]] and a supporter of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] city's magister [[Orlin Denache]] secretly signed a treaty with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], who was interested in making Taloraan a member of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. A [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Canteval]] was sent to the planet and local Separatist supporters led by Rynert began to smuggle [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] and [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] into the city.

Meanwhile, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] arrived at [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]] to ensure that the planet remained loyal to the Republic, accompanied by Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. After Tano and the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C9-RX0]] accidentally discovered [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] stocked within the city, Rynert destroyed the droid and tried to take on the padawan as well, but was Force-pushed into the wall by Tano, who managed to escape. Rynert immediately reported the fact to Canteval, who ordered the droids to attack the Jedi, revealing the Separatist presence within the city. Kenobi and Skywalker tried to reach their [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]], but were incapacitated when the shuttle was blown up by Rynert. Rynert intended to kill the Jedi, but emissary [[Sech Govlinder]] insisted that the Jedi be taken into custody instead.

After securing the Jedi in the warehouse, Rynert tried to re-establish contact with Canteval and left for the upper city platform to try to acquire a better signal. While he was gone, Sech Govlinder freed both Jedi and led them to the city's central communication tower, where the Jedi were able to patch a message to their [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]. Rynert informed Canteval that the ship was within their firing range, but without the element of surprise Canteval's ''Munificent'' was unable to overpower the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator'']] on its own. With its shield weakening, the Munificent took several direct hits into its engines and, unable to maintain altitude, was sucked into the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant's]] core.

Meanwhile, the ''Resolute'' has sent several [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] with clone reinforcements to help the loyalists regain control of the city. Rynert and his followers tried to hold, but against the combined strength of the Jedi, [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], [[Denfrandi]] loyalists and the [[Wind Raiders/Legends|Wind Raiders]] they were outmatched.
